mainEntity.name: How does AI-optimized AEO differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO primarily focuses on ranking for keywords and driving organic traffic through various on-page and off-page tactics. AI-optimized AEO, while still incorporating SEO principles, specifically targets the nuanced understanding of user intent and the delivery of direct answers. It prepares content for answer engines and voice search by optimizing for structured data, question-and-answer formats, and conciseness. While SEO aims for high rankings, AEO aims for direct answers in featured snippets, knowledge panels, and voice search results, often resulting in immediate visibility and authority.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI-optimized AEO focuses on providing direct answers for answer engines and voice search, whereas traditional SEO aims for general keyword rankings and organic traffic.
